note: Former Spaarbank voor de Stad Amsterdam, Singel 542-548 / Reguliersdwarsstraat (K.L. Sijmons Dzn, designed 1956-61, BAG 1965; gemeentelijk monument 200738). Register: four office storeys over the ground floor with its entresol, the top one set back; travertine (Waldinger) cladding; original timber frames with pivot sashes; glazed spandrels make the front an outspoken modernist raster; the set-back top storey is an abstract cornice on the Singel; the Reguliersdwarsstraat front differs little but its ground floor is more closed and it lacks the cornice. The 'curved' look of the Reguliersdwarsstraat front in the aimed panorama views is lens distortion: the BAG edge and the rectified crop are straight.
